caption: The drawing depicts two views of a single spoon on a plain beige background. On the left side of the image, there is a front view of the spoon showing the full design: the head of the spoon has a shell-like form with fluted lines radiating outward, and the handle narrows slightly before widening again toward the blunted end, which contains some cursive writing. The coloring is primarily composed of shades of gray with white highlights, suggesting a reflective metallic surface. To the right of the front view, there is a profile view of the same spoon, displaying its curved form and the scoop of the bowl. Both views are rendered in a simple, realistic style and occupy the left-center portion of the otherwise empty background.
title: Silver Salt Spoon
